title: OAuth app consent followed by sensitive cloud file access
summary: A finance director granted OAuth consent to an unverified third-party app. Within the next hour, the app used delegated Graph API permissions to enumerate SharePoint and OneDrive content, download sensitive board files, create external sharing links, and stage data to an external cloud storage domain.
detection_logic: Unverified OAuth app granted high-risk scopes followed by Graph API file access, sensitive SharePoint downloads, external sharing, and DLP policy matches within 60 minutes.
threshold: New OAuth consent grant with Files.Read.All or Mail.Read plus 3 or more sensitive file operations from a non-corporate source IP.
false_positive_notes: Approved enterprise SaaS integrations may request broad permissions during deployment.
Security engineering test apps may generate Graph API enumeration in controlled windows.
Board portal migrations may trigger bulk access if tied to an approved change request.
